name: ECOSPHEARE • Lumière utile
invariants: Original premium photorealistic optical sculpture, clear liquid-glass material
Seamless ultramarine studio floor and background, soft contact shadows
Orthographic three-quarter camera, upper-left softbox, restrained bloom
One readable business mechanism, left-to-right reading when sequential
Entire sculpture visible, generous margins, no irrelevant objects
White light means prospect intent; acid yellow means useful action, never guaranteed success

subjects.acquisition: Three white beams pass through one convex clear lens and converge at a yellow focal point. Meaning: searches meet an appropriate offer.
subjects.conversion: Three clear glass portals crossed by one white light path, ending at one yellow bead. Meaning: understand the offer, reassurance, contact.
subjects.suivi: One glass channel branches into three ordered parallel tracks, yellow beads at distinct stages. Meaning: centralize, qualify, organize follow-up.
subjects.mesure: A clear glass near-circular loop with four junctions and one yellow signal bead. Meaning: observe, understand, adjust. No chart.
